description: Open-source desktop security monitor for Windows with network connection analysis, threat-intelligence feeds, and firewall management.
notes: Review status: upstream confirms this Windows setup file is a Tauri-generated NSIS installer configured for current-user installation. The installer is not code-signed; verify the published SHA256 before installation.

The manifest's silent NSIS install and uninstall commands, installed executable path, and background auto-start cleanup have not yet been smoke-tested on Windows with Scoop. Keep this manifest under review until install, upgrade, and uninstall are tested.
The application includes its own updater. Set its update mode to Off or Notify me to avoid it replacing Scoop-managed files independently.
The app downloads and evaluates threat-intelligence feeds. Some sources and online lookup tiers are restricted to non-commercial use; select the appropriate usage mode in the app.
